candidates.description: This vector represents modal verbs, auxiliary markers, and future-tense indicators across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents the Thai preposition "ใน" (meaning "in" or "within") along with its common contextual suffixes, spelling variations, and English translation equivalents.
This feature vector activates on possessive markers, prepositions, and structural prefixes across multiple languages.
This vector represents the Thai consonant 'ก' (ko kai), often combined with various Thai vowel signs and tone marks.
This vector activates for Thai script characters, tone marks, and vowel diacritics.
This feature vector represents common Thai text fragments, grammatical particles, and sub-word tokens frequently appearing in web-scale corpora.
This feature vector activates strongly on adverbs and qualifiers indicating frequency, condition, or emphasis.
This feature vector activates on proper nouns and common nouns that denote specific geographical locations or administrative regions.
This feature vector activates on common Thai syllable fragments and English name components, particularly associated with place names like "town" and proper nouns.
This vector is related to Thai script characters and vowel markers combined with the consonant 'อ'.
